svg.title: Telescoping along each leaf path also writes this as its degree times its nearest internal parent’s exponent, summed over leaves. Direct output rate is E −maroot, tested remainder rate E −(m + 1)aroot. NE1 adds slack ε P v ∆v to this engineering rate. When P v av = 1, this slack is positive: some av > 0 and each av is bounded by the sum of all nonnegative advances. It absorbs fixed constants even when individual gaps vanish.
